purpose: Adjudicate unresolved prerequisite candidates using exact source, capability, assessment, and graph evidence without converting source order, domain order, cognitive level, intuition, or unsupported pedagogy into a hard prerequisite.

candidate_universe.source: All unresolved_dependency_candidates emitted by the passed 66-node structural topology population.
candidate_universe.ordering: Deterministic topology-input order from the full structural closure, then candidate order within each topology artifact.
candidate_universe.replay_rule: A candidate with a sealed adjudication disposition must not be re-adjudicated unless an explicitly newer Learning-owner evidence artifact invalidates the prior evidence basis.

admission_rules: A hard prerequisite may be admitted only when the evidence shows that the target capability is materially invalid, uninterpretable, or not independently performable without the source capability.
Every admitted prerequisite must identify both exact endpoint identities, a concrete dependency rationale, and exact evidence references.
Source order, domain order, numerical order, cognitive level, topic similarity, common teaching sequence, or evaluator preference is insufficient by itself.
SOURCE_EXPLICIT may be used only when the frozen source itself explicitly establishes the dependency; otherwise any admitted owner-derived edge remains LEARNING_OWNER_DERIVED_PROVISIONAL.

Assessment-target evidence may support a dependency only when the target's supplied evidence or required action demonstrably requires the source capability; it may not be used to infer learner mastery or effectiveness.
If available evidence supports useful sequencing but not a hard prerequisite, reject the hard-prerequisite candidate rather than silently weakening the evidence threshold.
If the evidence remains incomplete or competing interpretations remain plausible, retain REMAIN_UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL or DEFER_TO_SEPARATE_HUMAN_OR_SME_EVIDENCE.
graph_safety_rules: Every admitted endpoint must resolve to an existing frozen requirement or its uniquely parented provisional subskill.
The admitted PREREQUISITE graph must remain acyclic after every batch.
No adjudication may alter the 66 frozen requirement identities, source locators, cognitive levels, provisional subskill identities, capability statements, or 66 passed assessment targets.
No unresolved candidate may disappear without an explicit adjudication record.
No newer source revision may substitute for the frozen 2022 requirement set.

must_pass: Every selected candidate has exactly one explicit disposition.
Every disposition carries exact endpoint and evidence references.
Every admitted prerequisite satisfies the material-capability-dependency rule.
No order-only, level-only, similarity-only, or preference-only prerequisite is admitted.
All admitted endpoints resolve and the resulting prerequisite graph remains acyclic.
All untouched unresolved candidates remain present and noncanonical.
The 66 frozen requirements, 66 provisional subskills, and 66 assessment targets remain unchanged.
Protected human, SME, psychometric, A-01, native, and production evidence boundaries remain unchanged.

completion_rule: The machine-evidence adjudication lane completes when every unresolved candidate has an explicit evidence-bounded disposition or is explicitly deferred to a separate human/SME evidence lane; completion does not require forcing every candidate into an admitted prerequisite edge.
